entries.body: The owner requested six more exam rooms after the permit set went out. That work is outside our base scope and has not been invoiced, which is why hours are running ahead of billings.
Price the six added exam rooms from an hours report and send the owner an additional services request.
Glad to look over the request before it goes out, if that helps.
Hours report done: 412 hours on the added rooms, about $58,000. Request drafted; sending after Josh looks at it.
Request went to the owner Sep 28. No answer yet, so nothing has been billed against it.
Meet the owner's rep on site, walk the added rooms, and get the request signed.
Punch list and closeout ran three months long. We have kept staffing CA at full design-phase levels.
Move CA to one person at 10 hours a week and close the punch list by mid-November.
Punch list is down to three items. CA is at about 10 hours a week.
The door supplier raised its price 11% after we fixed the fee, and we have been absorbing the redesign for the new door.
Send the owner a change order for the door supplier's price increase.
Final inspection slipped twice, so we kept CA hours going longer than the fee allowed.
Close out the project after final inspection; no more CA hours after it.
Final inspection passed Sep 15. Closeout package is with the owner.
CA hours stopped after inspection. September's loss was about $800, down from $2,000 a month.
Bill the retainage now that the last invoice has gone out.
The client changed the lobby layout twice during construction documents. We redrew it both times without asking for a fee.
Ask for an additional services fee for the two lobby redesigns.
The client's project manager is out until October. Nobody else can approve it.
Still waiting on the client's project manager; he is back Oct 12.
We put a senior team on a warehouse with a thin fee, and the structural consultant's fee doubled after the racking change.
Move the remaining CD sheets to two junior staff and narrow the structural consultant's scope to the racking only.
Juniors have the sheets. Consultant agreed to a reduced scope.
September labor cost was about 30% lower than August.
Invoice the racking redesign as an additional service; the owner asked for it in writing.
Two rounds of dental equipment changes from the client after design development.
Ask for a fee adjustment for the equipment changes.
Sent the adjustment request with the hours behind it.
A small loss from extra site visits during the drive-through rebuild.
Hold site visits to the two in the contract.
This one is small. Worth a word only if it grows.
The fee was set for one hangar bay; the owner added the second bay without a new agreement, and we have been designing both.
Get a new agreement for the second hangar bay before any more design on it.
The base's contracting office says a new agreement takes 60 days. Work on the second bay continues meanwhile.
Should we pause the second bay until the agreement is in place? Let's talk at the PIC meeting.
Paused design on the second bay until the agreement is signed. Told the owner in writing.
Roof testing found wet insulation, and the redesign was not in our scope.
Send the city an additional services request for the redesign.
Tenant change requests during CDs. We never priced them.
Bill the unbilled tenant change requests from July and August.
Invoiced the July changes. August's are with accounting.
About $6,000 billed in September for the change requests.
Stop drawing tenant changes until each one is priced and approved.
The owner's interior designer keeps changing the casework, and we redraw it each time.
Send casework changes to the designer to draw, and only review them.
Owner agreed. The designer draws the casework now.
No casework hours since Sep 16.
The lab equipment list changed after design development and our MEP consultant billed us for the redesign.
Pass the MEP consultant's redesign cost through to the owner as an additional service.
Owner agreed in principle; paperwork with their contracts office.
The community engagement meetings ran three times longer than planned.
Ask the city to pay for the extra engagement meetings as an additional service.
